name: vscode-mcp-server
description: Turn VS Code into an MCP server — file ops, symbols, diagnostics, tests, and persistent memory for AI coding assistants.

vscode-mcp-server.port.description: The port number for the MCP server

vscode-mcp-server.host.description: Host address for the MCP server

vscode-mcp-server.defaultEnabled.description: Whether the MCP server should be enabled by default on VS Code startup

markdownEnumDescriptions: A random secret is generated once and required on every call (recommended)
You pin the secret yourself in #vscode-mcp-server.auth.staticToken#
MCP OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration — what remote clients like Mammouth require
No authentication (any local process or web page can run tools — not recommended)
vscode-mcp-server.auth.mode.description: How clients must authenticate to the MCP endpoint.

vscode-mcp-server.auth.staticToken.description: Token required when auth.mode is static-token. Pick a long random string (32+ characters).

vscode-mcp-server.auth.allowedOrigins.description: Extra Origin values allowed besides the server's own (e.g. https://mammouth.ai when it calls through a tunnel). Browser requests from other sites stay blocked.

vscode-mcp-server.auth.allowNoOrigin.description: Accept requests that carry no Origin header (curl, SDK clients). Browsers always send Origin on cross-site posts, so this does not weaken the drive-by protection.

file.description: Enable file operations tools (read, write, list files)

edit.description: Enable file editing tools (create, edit, delete files)

symbol.description: Enable code symbol and structure analysis tools

memory.description: Enable persistent memory tools (load, save, search, clear)

test.description: Enable testing tools (run tests, coverage, format, lint, diff)

git.description: Enable git workflow tools (commit, branch, blame, conflicts, stash)

documentation.description: Enable documentation tools (dependencies, history, docstrings, project context, TODOs)

database.description: Enable developer productivity tools (SQL queries, API tests, env vars, ports, dev server)

productivity.description: Enable AI productivity tools (dead code finder, workspace snapshots, regex tester, encoding converter)

security.description: Enable security tools (secret scanning, risky-construct scan, dependency audit)

performance.description: Enable performance tools (bundle analysis, server report, command profiling)

refactoring.description: Enable refactoring tools (rename symbol, extract function, duplicate finder, suggestions)

frontend.description: Enable frontend tools (accessibility audit, CSS analysis, element inspection, unused CSS)

workflow.description: Enable workflow tools (task runner, build detection, snippets, shell aliases)

advanced.description: Enable advanced tools (server info with local usage stats, extension inventory)

vscode-mcp-server.enabledTools.description: Configure which MCP tools are enabled

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
